name: Asahina Iori
source:
Birth Date: 1992/04/17.
Occupation: 3rd year student at a mission-based prestigious private high school.

Iori is the 10th son of the Asahina family. He is a high school senior and is known for having a prince-like behavior. He is very popular, even well known in other high schools. He is very accepting of [url=/c10574]Ema[/url] when she comes in to the family. Iori has a knowledge of any type of flower and what they mean. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_Conflict#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
